title: Driver
description:
We are hiring for the position of **pick up and drop driver** for our various branches at **Coimbatore**.

**Roles and Responsibilities :**

* On time Vehicle Collection \& Delivery
* Customer Communication should be good
* Customer satisfaction is must

**Work location :** Coimbatore (Various Branches)

**Benefits :** Incentives, Travel allowances, Uniform provided.

**Experience** : Fresher and Experienced

**Requirements :**

* **License:** Must have a valid **Permanent LMV (Light Motor Vehicle) Driving License**.

Interested candidates can apply directly through Indeed or visit our Coimbatore Head Office (Ramanathapuram) for a walk\-in interview.

**Thanks \& Regards,**

**HR Manager**

Pay: ₹18,000\.00 \- ₹30,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person
